summary: Develop AI inventories, risk records, and oversight dashboards using recognized governance frameworks. Explore the five-day training outline.
lede: AI governance training shows risk, compliance, product and technology teams how to oversee AI use with the NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001:2023. Over five days you practise keeping an AI use-case inventory, recording risk and impact assessments, and deciding who approves each system. You also learn to track model changes and report open risks to the people accountable for them.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review, approve, operate, or report on AI use and need practical governance records that support accountable decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with AI-enabled products, services, or organizational workflows is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use governance scenarios and spreadsheet-based records.
